thread:
Avery: Quick follow-up on the adaptive-pin metadata proposal — we need to pick how pins express compatibility, TTL, and fallback priority. Thoughts?

Kai: TL;DR: prefer explicit compat_bands + priority. makes routing deterministic and easy to reason about. e.g., `compat_bands: [{min_semver: "1.2.0", max_semver: "1.4.9", priority: 100}]`

Marta: Agree. Also strongly want `provenance` and `confidence` fields so we can tie regressions back to a rollout. telemetry keys: pin_id, origin, confidence_score. :thinking_face:

Devon: How do we evolve this without breaking old clients? defaulting rules? clients might ignore unknown fields but server->client assumptions need care.

Avery: initial sketch (very small):

```json
{
  "pin_id": "tenant-xyz/v1",
  "schema_version": "1",
  "type": "soft",        // enum: "soft" | "hard" | "sticky"
  "ttl_seconds": 86400,   // 0 => infinite
  "compat_bands": [
    {"min_semver": "1.2.0", "max_semver": "1.4.9", "priority": 10},
    {"min_semver": "1.5.0", "max_semver": "1.5.9", "priority": 5}
  ],
  "origin": "rollout-service", // who created the pin
  "confidence": 0.92, // ops-friendly number 0..1
  "deprecated_by": null
}
```

Kai: nit: prefer `min_semver`/`max_semver` as strings (you used them above) to avoid numeric parsing bugs. Also suggest `observe_only` flag for canaries (client will try fallback but won't error).

Marta: +1 to `observe_only`. Also add `safety_tags` string[] (eg: ["sensitive-kms", "no-cache"]) so console filters can protect certain pins from broad release.

Devon: ops question — what does `priority` mean when multiple bands match? need deterministic tie-breaker. also what happens if no band matches? fallback to routing policy (region/default-model).

Avery: proposal: higher `priority` wins. ties resolved by `created_at` (earlier = wins). If no match -> use tenant fallback rules + route to `best_effort_variant`. We'll document tie-breaker.

release-bot: notice: rollout-config update queued for tenant-xyz (dry-run) at 1761234580.

Kai: we should allow `deprecated_by` to point to the successor `pin_id` so automated GC/roll-forward can suggest targets.

Marta: add `schema_version` as shown so we can add fields without breaking server expectations. controllers should validate unknown schema_version and reject if unsupported.

Avery: action items: 1) I will open RFC with schema + examples, 2) tiny proto change for client libs (backwards compatible), 3) docs for tie-breaker + TTL semantics. @Devon can you add pin telemetry fields to Console (pin_id, origin, confidence, observe_only)?

Devon: yep will add dashboard filters and expose `pin_id`, `origin`, `confidence`, `safety_tags`. will add an admission metric for `observe_only` pins.

Kai: :thumbsup: happy with the direction.

Marta: :eyes: will review RFC — watch out for leaking KMS/HSM attributes in `provenance` or `origin`. we should sanitize provenance before exposing outside ops.

Avery: good catch, Marta. we'll add `provenance_sanitized: boolean` and redact sensitive keys by default.

Avery: RFC draft link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/rfcs/pull/XXX — started. expected PR for client libs by EOD Fri.

Devon: noted. I'll add a console ticket and link to the RFC.

Avery: thanks all. follow-up sync after RFC comments close. :coffee:
